parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. Call [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~) to view the latest Alibaba Cloud region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type definition. Currently, only `instance` is supported.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
Tag key. Limits:

- Cannot be empty.

- Supports up to 128 characters.

- Cannot start with aliyun or acs:.

- Cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
Tag value. Limits:

- Supports up to 128 characters.

- Cannot start with aliyun or acs:.

- Cannot contain http\:// or https\://.
